items.title: Bayern wint Duitse Super Cup en verpest Dortmund-debuut Veerman
items.summary: Bayern München heeft zaterdagavond beslag gelegd op de Franz Beckenbauer Super Cup. In het Duitse equivalent van de Johan Cruijff Schaal werd Borussia Dortmund met 1-2 verslagen. Joey Veerman en Ismael Saibari maakten hun debuut voor hun nieuwe clubs.

items.title: VI Live: dolblije Viergever schiet PEC op voorsprong, Real Madrid nog zoekende
items.summary: Zaterdag staan er drie wedstrijden in de Eredivisie op het programma, maar ook in het buitenland wordt weer volop gevoetbald. Zo spelen Manchester United en Tottenham Hotspur in de Premier League, Real Madrid in La Liga en spelen Borussia Dortmund en Bayern München de Duitse Super Cup. Blijf op de hoogte in deze VI Live.

items.title: Bristol Rovers-spits doet een 'Adebayortje' na goal tegen ex-werkgever
items.summary: Bobby Kamwa heeft zaterdag naam gemaakt als de 'Emmanuel Adebayor' van de Engelse League Two-club Bristol Rovers. De spits kopieerde na een doelpunt tegen zijn ex-werkgever Newport County de befaamde celebration van Adebayor als doelpuntenmaker voor Manchester City tegen Arsenal in september 2009.

items.title: Correia tevreden over spel Utrecht ondanks gelijkspel: 'Niet huilen, maar doorpakken'
items.summary: FC Utrecht pakte zaterdagavond het eerste punt van het nieuwe seizoen . Anthony Correia was tevreden met het spel van zijn ploeg, maar zag dat dit niet genoeg was voor de eerste zege. Toch is hij optimistisch. 'Dit smaakt naar meer.'

items.title: De Zerbi biedt excuses aan na Spurs-debacle en rept over 'leerproces'
items.summary: Tottenham Hotspur-manager Roberto De Zerbi heeft zijn verontschuldigingen aangeboden aan de achterban van Spurs na de pijnlijke nederlaag op bezoek bij Brentford . Met een gerenoveerd elftal bleek Tottenham kansloos in de Londense derby.

items.title: Brentford beat lacklustre Spurs in comfortable opening day win
items.summary: Tottenham Hotspur's Premier League season under Roberto De Zerbi gets off to a dismal start as they lose 3-0 to a dominant Brentford side at the Gtech Community Stadium.

items.title: Late drama as Ipswich stun Sunderland
items.summary: Ipswich Town beat Sunderland as Jack Clarke scores a 90th minute winner to open their account on their return to the Premier League.

items.title: Leeds score late winner to silence Forest fans
items.summary: Anton Stach scores in the 88th minute to give Leeds United a win in Oliver Glasner's first game in charge of Nottingham Forest in the Premier League.

items.title: Wasteful Palace punished by Everton in Sage's first game
items.summary: Everton beat Crystal Palace 2–0 to win their opening game of the Premier League season for the first time in five years, with goals from Kiernan Dewsbury‑Hall and Thierno.

items.title: Hull shock Man Utd with dream Premier League return
items.summary: Watch highlights as Hull City make a dream start to their return to the Premier League, beating Manchester United 2-0 on the opening weekend at the MKM Stadium.

items.title: Kayode seals emphatic Brentford victory in wake-up call for sorry Spurs
items.summary: Continue down this road and it will not be long before the chants of “Lincoln away” start up again. This was the start of Tottenham’s brave new era but there was no sign of any change. The old flaws were still there in a cowardly display – with and without the ball – and after a summer of extravagant spending it will alarm Roberto De Zerbi that his side opened the season looking like relegation candidates rather than contenders for European football. If anything it was a reminder than winning the transfer window is not the same as winning on the pitch. There has been plenty of excitable predictions about Spurs, whose outlay will soon surpass £300m, but are they based on anything substantial? Not on the evidence of this game. There were no patterns of play from Spurs. They were timid in possession and chaotic at the back. They failed to perform the basics and they crumbled in the face of relentless pressing from Brentford, whose blend of power, speed and skill revealed a team determined to kick on in their second season under Keith Andrews. items.title: Infantino angers Concacaf nations by hijacking meeting in Caribbean
items.summary: Gianni Infantino used opportunity to lobby for support Fifa president was asked to stay away from CFU meeting Gianni Infantino has risked alienating numerous Concacaf nations, whose support he is seeking in his re-election campaign, by hijacking a meeting of the Caribbean Football Union (CFU) to announce Fifa-funded development projects for the region with millions of dollars that had been delayed for months. Multiple sources attending the CFU meeting in the Dominican Republic said many of the Concacaf members were infuriated by Infantino’s behaviour, particularly as he had been asked to stay away by their president, Victor Montagliani. Continue reading...

items.title: Anton Stach snatches late Leeds winner to sour Glasner’s new dawn at Forest
items.summary: For Anton Stach, another sweet direct free-kick to add to the back catalogue, this one souring Oliver Glasner’s first match in charge of Nottingham Forest. Only Dominik Szoboszlai eclipsed Stach’s record of three direct free-kick goals in the Premier League last season, one of those coming against Glasner’s Crystal Palace. Stach’s latest right-foot strike earned Leeds, fresh from a near-flawless pre-season and an expensive and exciting summer in the market, a divine opening-day victory with a couple of minutes of normal time remaining. Continue reading...

items.title: Burnham’s boys enjoy visit from Palace as Everton ease to opening day win
items.summary: Andy Burnham was in the posh seats to see how his beloved Everton would fare without the key additions that even the prime minister has voiced an opinion on. No right-back, no new centre-forward, no problem: Everton contained enough quality to overcome a wasteful Crystal Palace. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall and Iliman Ndiaye delivered a timely reminder that, despite the missing pieces in the squad, there is pedigree and Premier League knowhow available to David Moyes as he attempts to sustain a challenge for European qualification this season. Continue reading...

items.title: Carrick tells Manchester United to keep calm and carry on after Hull humbling
items.summary: Bruno Fernandes: ‘We gave too much of the ball to them’ Sergej Jakirovic happy Hull proved critics wrong Michael Carrick says he will not overreact, but has called for improvement after Manchester United started the season with a 2-0 defeat at Hull. United lost their opening game for the fourth time in the past seven years as Semi Ajayi and Nobel Mendy took advantage of poor defending from set-pieces. The United head coach presented a professional exterior despite United’s performance not reaching the desired standard as they were deservedly beaten by Hull, who finished sixth in the Championship last season. items.title: Geen play-offs meer, dus één fout weegt veel zwaarder: wie wordt de verrassing van de Jupiler Pro League?
items.summary: De Jupiler Pro League is dit seizoen nauwelijks nog te herkennen. Met achttien clubs, 34 speeldagen en zonder play-offs begint België aan een nieuw tijdperk. Dat verandert niet alleen de titelstrijd, maar ook de strijd onderin.

items.title: LIVE: Genkse invallers rollen Antwerp helemaal op
items.summary: Na drie speeldagen staat de eerste echte topper op het programma in de Jupiler Pro League. Antwerp ontvangt zaterdagavond Racing Genk. De Great Old zag zijn ploeg al 6 op 6 pakken terwijl RC Genk het seizoen opende met 3 op 6. Blijft het perfecte rapport behouden of komt Genk op gelijke hoogte?

items.title: Un comble après la révolte contre le Standard : le fait de match presque rarissime entre Charleroi et Malines
items.summary: Malines n'a pratiquement rien montré contre Charleroi. Fred Vanderbiest est bien embêté par le manque de mordant des visiteurs. Le contraste saute aux yeux après le partage arraché de haute lutte contre le Standard le week-end dernier.
